name: A_growth
prompt:
ONE finished high-resolution portrait phone screen mockup, requested 1024x2208, same approximately 390:844 aspect ratio as the screenshot. Fill the canvas with the app screen, no phone hardware, no outside presentation background, no multi-screen layout. Original fantasy game UI; no existing game logos or copied UI components. Traditional Chinese text, carefully typeset and readable with hierarchy and strong contrast. This is a design concept image, not executable UI.

ART DIRECTION A 王城藍金: Regal deep navy and gold filigree frames, polished brass corners, parchment inner panels, elegant serif-like Traditional Chinese headers. Refined royal fantasy menus: restrained fine gilded ornament, legible warm ivory text, crisp navy structures, parchment selected-detail panel, strong gold primary buttons. Expensive, orderly, distinct from flat generic rounded blue boxes. Ornament supports hierarchy and never crowds small text.

The FIRST reference is the current GROWTH screen. Retain its pixel-art hero identities and the functional information architecture: header, five-member march squad, six class tabs, class upgrade row, scrollable four-column hero grid, selected hero detail, and three bottom action buttons. Redesign only the UI presentation in the requested visual style. Preserve the pixel-art medium of all hero portraits/sprites; do not substitute unrelated anime or 3D characters. Use the tall phone canvas intelligently with comfortable spacing and clear priority. Show EXACTLY these Traditional Chinese labels/content: top title 養成, 金幣 1,280, 突破素材 3. A 行軍小隊 with exactly FIVE hero portrait slots; each shows name, rarity and level and a 行軍 marker. Six tabs 盾、劍、槍、弓、法、補, with 劍 clearly selected. Class row 劍 職業等級 14　全職業英雄 ×2.72 and a button 升級（272 金）. A visibly scrollable hero collection grid with FOUR columns, approximately three visible rows: pixel portraits, names including 蘿德、伊妮、蒂斯、佩文, rarity colours N grey, R blue, SR purple, SSR gold, levels and breakthrough stars. Selected hero detail: 蘿德　SSR 劍; Lv 4／10　突破 ★0　招牌技「斷鋼斬」+0%; an experience progress bar; buttons 突破（1 素材） and 派去行軍. Bottom has THREE large distinct buttons 行軍 1 小時, 一鍵養成, 開始推王. Keep these all visible; do not let the detail card cover the bottom actions. Make 開始推王 the clearest primary action. Use the actual sword hero pixel identity from the screenshot for the selected character.

name: A_battle
prompt:

Refined royal fantasy menus: restrained fine gilded ornament, legible warm ivory text, crisp navy structures, parchment selected-detail panel, strong gold primary buttons. Expensive, orderly, distinct from flat generic rounded blue boxes. Ornament supports hierarchy and never crowds small text.

Reference 1 is the current battle with red warning circles: preserve its dusk ruined-fortress valley stage, 3D ground, warm upper-left sunlight, cool shadows, pixel-art army crowds on the left, crimson sword/shield melee flag, azure bow/staff ranged flag, golden sun-ring support flag, and the giant horned club troll on the right. Reference 2 shows the signature skill card and pixel mage avatar; use it for functional content and the avatar identity only, replace its old UI chrome. All required widgets must fit without obscuring the flags or army silhouettes. UI colours must coexist with the red/blue/gold team flags.
